replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
First I'll focus on the map. Its very flat, very bland and nothing special. Theres some iron supplies, couple of monuments and a spawn. Its all connected by flat paths. 

The side islands look like they could bring some interesting gameplay but IMO don't fit there. I'd rather see a middle area that one larger island than the current 5. The islands with the trees are also nothing special. If you do go for one large island then also make the void gap smaller.

The aesthetics are nothing too great. Its a very basic map, stone and grass everywhere and nothing unique.

The name also IMO doesn't fit the best.

So overall, the map is nothing new in terms of the layout or the looks. Its very flat and not that special BUT that doesn't mean you should give up. With some work and improvements you could change my look on the map and make it stand out and be really good. Don't give up, keep trying. Every map has potential.

Now for some comments.
@slicornV2
To make things clear. Cardinal is NOT an Overcast Network plugin. It is a scrimmage plugin that works similar to PGM (Overcast Network's plugin) but it is not made by Overcast Network developers. Its not a part of Overcast Network, its a community made plugin for scrimming. As for the "stealing maps" part on page 1, I don't know what Avicus' policy on it exactly is but if theres a public download in the thread, you don't have anything to worry about.

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
I am sorry to say but your map, Renegade, has been denied from testing for the Avicus Network.

To Improve your map, the map developers suggest you add more platforms and remove the void. This map looks like every map we have in the rotations right now and we would like some unique maps. The gameplay also looks stale and boring so if you can edit that, it would be great. The map looks flat and some parts such as the floor look plain and should be edited. Like I stated above, please try to edit the map and make it more unique and something different compared to our current maps.


If you have any other questions on how to improve your map, Find me on TeamSpeak or Message me on Skype (Sethskye).


You May resubmit your map once edited.
